# PASR — Provenance-Aware Span Recall

> PASR is a local source-context MCP server. Live select_context bounds its returned
> context, including provenance labels and headings; JSON envelopes, catalogs, and
> cumulative model history are separate costs. Receipt persistence is best-effort,
> covering only PASR-delivered context, not a complete global agent audit.
> Query classification and keyword coverage are heuristics, not correctness or
> completeness guarantees. End-to-end superiority to native grep/read is unproven.
> Offline use requires installed dependencies and cached tokenizer encoding data.

Install version 0.4.0: https://pypi.org/project/pasr-mcp/0.4.0/
Separate GitHub release wheel/sdist location:
https://github.com/Apheironn/pasr/releases/tag/v0.4.0
Install uv, make uvx available on PATH, and use Python 3.10+ (or let uv provision it).
No PASR checkout is required:
`uvx --from pasr-mcp==0.4.0 pasr-mcp --workspace /absolute/path/to/project`.
MCP config: `{"command":"uvx","args":["--from","pasr-mcp==0.4.0","pasr-mcp","--workspace","/absolute/path/to/project"]}`.
Replace the workspace path with the project's absolute path. Update an existing
pasr registration instead of adding another. Package install: `pip install pasr-mcp==0.4.0`.
Without an agent, run `uvx --from pasr-mcp==0.4.0 pasr explain "<question>"` in the project.
Developers only: to run a PASR checkout, replace `pasr-mcp==0.4.0` after `--from`
with `/absolute/path/to/pasr` in the existing registration, not a second server.
This runs your checkout, which can differ from the version-pinned package.

Local selection does not prevent the client forwarding source to a cloud model.
Default redaction is a no-op, not automatic secret detection. Computed spans are
not guaranteed full functions or complete answer evidence.

## MCP tools

Default tools:
- find_files(query, include=None): lexical path/filename location.
- find_symbols(query, include=None): definitions, not complete bodies.
- find_evidence(query, include=None): ranked content locations; not semantic proof.
- find_usages(symbol, include=None): literal occurrences and enclosing-definition hints.
- select_context(query, files=None, include=None, budget_tokens=1500, outline=False,
  advanced=None): context from known files/ranges. Optional map_tokens, trace,
  semantic, pack, and save_as settings belong inside advanced. Every selection is
  independent; repeated requests resend source. Range-only body reads return ordered
  whole-line prefixes, not ranked fragments. Reissue continuation.files as files,
  without include; [] means the requested extant lines are exhausted. blocked=true
  means no body line fit: use more budget where possible or a direct reader (MCP cap
  1500). Compare shared-file source_fingerprint values before combining pages.
  Whole-file/mixed scopes remain ranked; outline returns definitions only.

Opt-in tools (`pasr-mcp --tools all`):
- trace_dependencies(symbol, files=None, include=None, max_depth=4,
  direction="dependencies"): bounded static name-reference approximation.
- explain_selection(receipt_id): retrieve a stored selection receipt.
- expand_context(receipt_id, extra_budget): reselect with more budget in the same scope.
- search_code(query): discover/select from up to three matching files. No files,
  include, or other scope arguments are accepted. Use returned paths for follow-ups.
- read_code(query, files): select from a required non-empty list of known paths/ranges;
  never guess paths. Migrate old search_code(query, files=...) calls here; old scoped
  discovery calls are rejected rather than silently widened.
  Both tools reject unknown arguments. Queries remain required and non-empty.
  Explicit empty/missing/directory/unsafe scopes fail; no automatic discovery occurs.
  Range-only reads return ordered prefixes, continuation.files, blocked, and
  source_fingerprint values. Compare shared fingerprints before combining pages.
  Stop on empty continuation.files or blocked=true; do not submit an empty list.
  Whole-file/mixed scopes remain ranked. Calls are independent.
  Both tools cap context at 1500 tokens. Discovery additionally prices JSON
  string quoting/escaping; read_code retains the former explicit-follow-up pricing.
  Advice/metadata still cost extra. Literal case-sensitive definitions get selection
  priority; compatible overlapping evidence is returned once. Not complete recall.
  Expose the opt-in pair with --tools search_code,read_code; default tools unchanged.
  This does not enforce a four-call limit or the experiments' host stopping policy.
  The compact pair does not persist receipts or append usage-ledger entries.
  Text replies contain raw source with an optional one-line JSON metadata header;
  MCP structuredContent contains the full response object.

The host owns question lifetime, stopping policy, and retained-context knowledge.
The server has no lifetime call ceiling or implicit source-holding state. Saved packs
larger than the requested selection budget (at most 1500) are rejected, not clipped.

## CLI

- pasr explain "<query>" [paths]: run a selection, print the receipt.
- pasr trace <symbol> [paths] [--callers]: a dependency closure.
- pasr pack <name> "<query>" [paths]: save a committable Context Pack.
- pasr review [--staged|--range|--diff]: changed-definition/caller context. Staged reads
  a pinned index tree; A..B/A...B reads pinned B; external --diff uses the working tree.
- pasr context --issue <text> [paths]: headless source context for CI / agents.
- pasr report [--price-per-mtok N]: source-context ledger estimates, not measured API savings.
- pasr doctor [--json] [--timeout SECONDS]: 0.4.0 runtime diagnostics.
  Invoke with `uvx --from pasr-mcp==0.4.0 pasr --workspace /absolute/path/to/project doctor --json`.
  It probes a disposable MCP fixture, not project
  source; no project writes, paid model calls or automatic uploads. Temporary and
  tokenizer-cache locations must be disjoint from the inspected workspace.
  Exit 0 means diagnostic success, 1 a failed check, 2 invalid options; a pass
  does not establish client registration, approval settings or answer quality.

0.4.0 report contract: tokens_saved is signed tokens_in - tokens_out,
recomputed from raw counters; negative means expansion. unmeasured_calls counts rows
missing valid nonnegative integer counters. Affected totals/daily differences and
cost estimates are null, not zero; zero input has no reduction ratio. Fully known
fields remain available. Prices must be finite/nonnegative; zero disables pricing.
Sub-cent differences are retained. Coverage is only parsed ledger rows within the
date filter, never a complete record of provider usage or agent costs.
Malformed/unfinished JSON, non-object records, invalid UTF-8 or read failures stop
the report with exit 2 and no stdout totals, even with --since. Record errors give
the physical line without raw contents. Blank lines and Unicode separators inside
query strings are handled separately. No automatic repair or file modification;
missing or empty ledgers still report no recorded rows, unlike unreadable ledgers.
Consumer migration: accept nullable counters/differences/ratios/costs and signed
differences. Never coerce null to zero or clamp expansion; treat exit 2 as failure,
not an empty report. Existing ledgers need no rewrite.

Packs and receipts use format 2. Rebuild/reselect format-1 records; they are not
automatically recertified. Source reads are strict UTF-8 (optional BOM), normalized
to LF. Fingerprints describe each actual read, not an atomic workspace snapshot.
Expansion reports changed source identities. Standalone dependency tracing has a
soft token target and may report within_budget=false.

## Current evidence (2026-10-05)

- All 10 PASR methods measured in 420 local calls / 35 modes. Local payload tokens
  are not cumulative provider usage or answer quality. Canonical selector probes
  explicitly used 1000 context tokens; the installed default remains 1500.
- 664 answering trajectories retained. The 40-question schedule attempted all
  400 cells: 398 answers, two failed requests with unknown usage and no retries.
  A separately recorded user approval allowed the remaining 128 distinct attempts
  after the connection-error halt; this is an amended descriptive continuation.
- Actual Aider RepoMap, Repomix and Serena components, not full-product coding
  agents, ran with a shared answering harness. Aider ran in development; the
  frozen quality-first rule selected Repomix for the five-arm confirmation.
- Selected prompt versus unchanged split-4, Luna: 12,677.825 versus 10,720.525 mean
  provider tokens, ratio 1.182575, paired 95% interval [1.04594, 1.35231].
  Full rubric/source support 4/40 versus 3/40; material-error answers 3 versus 5.
  Strict compound completeness is not ordinary answer accuracy.
- No pipeline promotion: token gates failed, usage is incomplete, and the
  continuation approval forbids promotion. Production retrieval defaults unchanged.
- Answering API: $0.636401240 known published-rate charges plus $0.008003750
  retained unknown reservations; conservative bound $0.644404990 under $5.
  Not an invoice; authoring/coding/review assistant-session tokens excluded.
- Full report: https://github.com/Apheironn/pasr/blob/main/docs/competitors-benchmark.md#fresh-workflow-study--2026-10-05
- Summary: https://github.com/Apheironn/pasr/blob/main/eval/agent_bench/workflow_study_20261005.json
- Evidence: https://github.com/Apheironn/pasr/releases/tag/workflow-study-20261005

## Earlier evidence (2026-10-03)

- Untouched 40-question confirmation: native/split supported 28/40 each, material
  errors 3/7; split used 25.3% fewer cumulative provider tokens. Primary gate failed.
- Exploratory reuse of the same 40 questions with GPT-6 Luna: native/split supported
  26/40 and 32/40, material errors 2/2. Mean tokens were 12,430.875 native known
  subtotal and 10,698.075 split. One interrupted native request has unknown usage.
  The combined quality/cost gate failed.
- The experimental split workflow used four host calls and conservative stopping,
  not the default installed configuration. Actual Aider RepoMap and Repomix
  components ran under a shared answering harness, not the full Aider coding agent.
  No universal quality/cost superiority or equivalent accuracy is established.
- Confirmation: https://github.com/Apheironn/pasr/blob/main/eval/agent_bench/reserved_confirm_20261003.json
- Exploratory matrix: https://github.com/Apheironn/pasr/blob/main/eval/agent_bench/cheap_market_20261003.json
